rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the afternoon of 2 June 2010 says that at the extraordinary cabinet meeting from 13:30 that day 鳩山総理 thanked the ministers and asked that, during the transition until the new cabinet was launched, no gap in government arise and crisis management in particular be kept fully in place (新しい内閣が発足するまでの間の政権移行期にあっては…危機管理等については万全を期す必要がある).
